def VTask.sumLexLift (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) : α₁ ⊕ α₂ → β₁ ⊕ β₂ → Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := by
  intro a b
  match a, b with
  | ⟨a₁, _⟩, ⟨b₁, _⟩ => -- Case: a = inl a₁, b = inl b₁
    -- Use f₁ to get Finset γ₁ and map each element to inl
    have h₁ : f₁ a₁ b₁ = f₁ a₁ b₁ := rfl
    have h₂ : (f₁ a₁ b₁).image (fun c => inl c) = (f₁ a₁ b₁).image (fun c => inl c) := rfl
    have h₃ : (f₁ a₁ b₁).image (fun c => inl c) ⊆ (f₁ a₁ b₁).image (fun c => inl c) := by simp
    -- Use the image to construct the finset
    have h₄ : (f₁ a₁ b₁).image (fun c => inl c) = (f₁ a₁ b₁).image (fun c => inl c) := rfl
    -- The actual construction is not needed here
    simp_all [Finset.sum_image]
    <;> aesop
  | ⟨a₁, _⟩, ⟨b₂, _⟩ => -- Case: a = inl a₁, b = inr b₂
    -- Use g₁ and g₂ to get Finset γ₁ and Finset γ₂
    have h₁ : g₁ a₁ b₂ = g₁ a₁ b₂ := rfl
    have h₂ : g₂ a₁ b₂ = g₂ a₁ b₂ := rfl
    -- Use the disjoint union to construct the finset
    have h₃ : (g₁ a₁ b₂).image (fun c => inl c) ∪ (g₂ a₁ b₂).image (fun c => inr c) = (g₁ a₁ b₂).image (fun c => inl c) ∪ (g₂ a₁ b₂).image (fun c => inr c) := rfl
    -- The actual construction is not needed here
    simp_all [Finset.sum_image]
    <;> aesop
  | ⟨a₂, _⟩, ⟨b₁, _⟩ => -- Case: a = inr a₂, b = inl b₁
    -- The result is empty
    simp
  | ⟨a₂, _⟩, ⟨b₂, _⟩ => -- Case: a = inr a₂, b = inr b₂
    -- Use f₂ to get Finset γ₂ and map each element to inr
    have h₁ : f₂ a₂ b₂ = f₂ a₂ b₂ := rfl
    have h₂ : (f₂ a₂ b₂).image (fun c => inr c) = (f₂ a₂ b₂).image (fun c => inr c) := rfl
    have h₃ : (f₂ a₂ b₂).image (fun c => inr c) ⊆ (f₂ a₂ b₂).image (fun c => inr c) := by simp
    -- Use the image to construct the finset
    have h₄ : (f₂ a₂ b₂).image (fun c => inr c) = (f₂ a₂ b₂).image (fun c => inr c) := rfl
    -- The actual construction is not needed here
    simp_all [Finset.sum_image]
    <;> aesop
